qualification.education_qualification: 8th, 10th, 12th, Diploma, Degree, MBBS, B.Sc, BPT, B.Pharm, DMLT
qualification.details: Medical Officer (HWC): MBBS Degree awarded by a University or Institution recognized by the UGC for the purpose of its grants. The Courses must have been approved by the Medical council of India. Tuberculosis Health Visitor (NTEP): Graduate in Science (OR) Intermediate (10 + 2 ) in science and experience of working as MPW / LHV / ANM / Health Worker Certificate. (OR) Higher course in Health Education / Counselling. (OR) Tuberculosis Health visitors recognized course. Certificate course in computer operations (Minimum Two Months). Lab Technician (NTEP): Intermediate (10 + 2 ) and Diploma or Certified Course in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent. 1 Year Experience in NTEP or Sputum Smear Microscopy. Senior Treatment supervisor (STS): Bachelor's Degree OR Recognized sanitary inspector's course -Tuberculosis health visitor's recognized course. Govt recognized degree/diploma in Social work or Medical Social work. Successful completion of basic training course (Govt recognized) for Multi-purpose health workers. Certificate course in computer operation (minimum2 months) Permanent two wheeler driving license & should be able to drive two wheeler. Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory supervisor (STLS): Graduate. Diploma in Medical Laboratory technology or equivalent from a govt recognized institution. Permanent two wheeler driving license & should be able to drive two wheeler. Certificate course in computer operations (Minimum two months) Minimum one year experience in RNTCP. Counsellor (ICTC): Graduate degree in Psychology/ Social Work/ Sociology/Anthropology/Human Development or Diploma in Nursing with minimum 3 years of experience in HIV/AIDS. Lab Technician (ICTC): Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)-2 years from state government approved institution only. Refrigeration Mechanic: Certificate course in ITI Refrigeration Mechanic & Air-Conditioning with One year experience. Security Guard: 8th Standard Pass and Able to read and write. Data Entry Operator: Graduate in any Degree. One year diploma in Computer Application. Typing speed of 40wpm in English. Mid-Level Health Provider: Diploma in GNM / B.Sc (Nursing) from Government or Government Approved Private Nursing Colleges which are recognised by the Indian Nursing Council / Completed Certified Course in Community Health Care under TN Dr MGR Medical University / COVID19 Experience Certificate. Health Inspector (MTM): Must have passed plus two with Biology or Botany and Zoology. Must have passed Tamil Language as a subject in S.S.L.C. level. Must possess two Years of Multipurpose Health Worker (Male) /Health Inspector/ Sanitary Inspector Course training. Hospital Worker / Support Staff (UHWC): Should have studied minimum 8th standard. Must be able to read and write. Multi Purpose Hospital Worker: 8th Standard Pass/Able to read and write for Tamil. Radiographer: B.Sc.Radiography. Physiotherapist: Bachelor of Physiotherapist (BPT) from any Recognized University. MMU Driver: 10th Pass / LMV Batch. UPHC Pharmacist: +2 Examination with Science Subject. Diploma in Pharmacy or Bachelor of Pharmacy. Must have registered with Tamil Nadu Pharmacy Council. ECHO Technician: Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Echocardiography/Echocardiography Technology/Cardiac Care Technology.

selection_process: Scrutiny of applications Interview / Non-Interview based on post requirements
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Erode Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://erode.nic.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Health Society, Erode (DHS Erode) in Tamil Nadu for filling various medical and administrative positions on a temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in DHS Erode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 78 vacancies available across various posts including Medical Officer, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Health Inspector, Data Entry Operator, and support staff roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed offline applications is 12 November 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DHS Erode Posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it by Speed Post or in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Medical Officer (HWC)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Medical Officer (HWC) post must possess an MBBS Degree awarded by a University or Institution recognized by the UGC and approved by the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for any of the categories applying for the District Health Society, Erode recruitment positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the advertised vacancies?
faq.answer: The monthly salary varies by post, ranging from Rs. 11,000 for support staff and security guard roles up to Rs. 63,000 for the Medical Officer position.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Chinthamani, Erode District, Erode - 638012 either in person or via Speed Post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DHS Erode jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the scrutiny of all received applications followed by an Interview or Non-Interview evaluation based on the specific requirements of each post.

faq.question: Q10. Are these positions permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No, all the advertised posts under the District Health Society, Erode are purely temporary on a contract basis and will not be regularized at any time.
